paite: "Huchi mah bang in hiai tatlek thoihdan ding ahi. Thil siangthoupen ahi.
heading: Ditkik Nawnna Thillat
english: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.

paite: Haltum thillat agoh zelna ua tatlek kithoihna leng goh ding ahi a; asisan a maitam theh kimvel ding ahi.
english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng alat ding ahi. Amei thautakte, asungkua thaute,
english: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh aboh thau, aphuk kiang a thau leh asin tuam lap, akalte nangawn in asuahkhe ding ahi.
english: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;

paite: Siampu in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ding in maitam tung ah ahal ding ahi. Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi.
english: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.

paite: Pasal siampu tengteng in ane ding ua; mun siangthou a nek ding ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

paite: "Tatlek thoihna pen khelh thoihna mah bang ahi a, dan khat ahi. Kilepna bawltu siampu in huai atang ding hi.
english: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

paite: Siampu, kuapeuh halmang thillat latsaktu siampu ngei in halmang thillat dia alat vun apum tan ding ahi.
english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

paite: Akanna a kan tangbuang thillat peuhmah, sikbel a kan leh kuang a kan tengteng alantu siampu atuam ding ahi.
english: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

paite: Tangbuang thillat tengteng sathau a mek leng, agaw leng adang mah bang in Aaron tapa tengteng akihawm dialdial ding uh ahi.
english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

paite: "Hiai pen mi'n TOUPA kiang a alat ding, lemna thillat a kithoihdan ding ahi.
heading: Bell Kituahna Thillat
english: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:

paite: Kipahthu genna dia alatleh kipahthu genna kithoihna ding in sathau a zut, silngou soh louh tanghou leh sathau a zut silngou soh louh tanghou pa didekte leh sathau a mek tangbuang nel mahmah kidiah suak a lat tel ding ahi.
english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

paite: "Kipahthu genna dia lemna thillat kithoihna ah tanghou silngou soh alat tel ding ahi.
english: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.

paite: Huai athillat teng a TOUPA a dia vei thillat a ding in khat chiat alan dia; lemna thillat sisan a thehtu siampu a tuam ding ahi.
english: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

paite: Kipahthu genna dia alemna thillat kithoihna sa pen thillat alat ni mah a nekgaih ding ahi. Azingchiang tan a bangmah asit ding ahi kei.
english: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

paite: "Himahleh athillat kithoihna pen thuchiam hiam, amah ut thu a thillat hiam ahihleh kithoihna alat ni mah a nek ding ahi a; nek bang azingchiang a nek ding ahi.
english: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

paite: Himahleh kithoihna sa, ani thum ni tan a-om lailaileh hal ding ahi.
english: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

paite: Alemna thillat kithoihna sa ani thum ni tan a anek uleh, pomsak ahi kei dia, alantu leng alan a sim ahi kei ding. Thilkihhuai ahi dia, kuapeuh ane in athulimlouhna moh uh apo ding hi.
english: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

paite: Thilsiang lou himhim toh kisukha sa nek ding ahi kei, hal ding ahi. Sa siang peuhmah nek ding ahi.
english: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;

paite: Himahleh lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam, siang lou nemi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

paite: Kuapeuh in thilsiang lou himhim, misiang lou hiam, gan siang lou hiam, thilkihhuai siang lou himhim akhoih a, lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam anekleh huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi, chi in Aaron leh atapate houpih in," achi hi.
english: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam thau na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

paite: Amah sih a si thau leh gamsa balzan thau thil dang a dia zat ding ahi. Na ne himhim ding uh ahi kei.
english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

paite: Kuapeuh, TOUPA a dia mi'n mei thillat alat uh sathau nemi, achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

paite: Na tenna peuh uah sisan himhim, vasa hiam, gamsa hiam sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

paite: Kuapeuh hitaleh, sisan ne himhim achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi, chi in Israel suante houpih in," achi hi.
english: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "TOUPA kiang a lemna thillat kithoihna lan peuhmah in, TOUPA a dia athillat, alemna thillat kithoihna a pan ahong lat ding ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

paite: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat amah khut mahmah in ahon tawi ding a; athau leh a-awm ahon la ding ahi; a-awm pen TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding a vei ahihtheihna ding in.
english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in maitam ah athau ahal dia, a-awm bel Aaron leh atapate a tuam ding ahi.
english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

paite: Aliang taklam pen kilemna thillat kithoihna a pan vei thillat dia siampu na piak ding uh ahi.
english: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

paite: Aaron tapate lak a lemna thillat sisan leh thau lantu kuapeuh in atantuan ding in aliang taklam atang ding ahi.
english: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

paite: A-awm leh aliang avei lel pen uh Israel suante a lemna thillat kithoihna a pan ka la tuam a, Israel suante tangtawn dan thuseh ding in siampu Aaron leh atapate ka pia ahi, chi in Israel suante kiang ah gen in," achi hi.
english: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

paite: Hiai ahi, siampu nasem dia TOUPA kiang a lat ahih nungsiah TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a pan Aaron tantuan leh atapate tantuan ding,
english: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;

paite: amau thau anilh ni a Israel suante'n dan thuseh a apiak gige ding ua TOUPA'N thu apiak. Hiai tangtawn a asuan hong om zel dingte tan a ahihdan ding uh ahi.
english: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

paite: Hiai ahi halmang thillat, tang- buang thillat, khelh thoihna leh tatlek kithoihna dan.
english: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings

paite: Sinai gamdai a Israel suante'n thillat TOUPA kiang a alat ding ua thu apiak ni a Sinai Tang a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak ahi.
english: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.
